## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Core color
//
// The shared color vocabulary. Color is linear-light RGBA with components
// nominally in [0, 1]; wide-gamut and HDR values may exceed 1. Additional color
// spaces and imaging types live in the `color-spaces-*`, `images*`,
// `image-processing-*` and `texturing*` files.

// A linear-light RGBA color (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/RGBA_color_model).
// The canonical color type for computation; interpolation and arithmetic are
// component-wise.
// Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Color (linear-light, straight alpha; A is
// straight; do not lerp/construct from sRGB bytes without decoding).
type Color
    implements INumerical
{
    R: Number;
    G: Number;
    B: Number;
    A: Number;
}

// An 8-bit-per-channel RGBA color with components in [0, 255]; storage and
// interop form, typically sRGB-encoded (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SRGB).
type Color8
    implements IValue, IHashable
{
    R: Integer;
    G: Integer;
    B: Integer;
    A: Integer;
}

// A color in hue-saturation-value form; Hue is an angle around the color wheel.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HSL_and_HSV)
type ColorHSV
    implements IValue
{
    Hue: Angle;
    Saturation: Number;
    Value: Number;
}

// A color in hue-saturation-lightness form; Hue is an angle around the color wheel.
// Same model family as HSV: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HSL_and_HSV
type ColorHSL
    implements IValue
{
    Hue: Angle;
    Saturation: Number;
    Lightness: Number;
}

// A color at a normalized position within a gradient; Position is in [0, 1].
type ColorStop
    implements IValue
{
    Position: Number;
    Color: Color;
}

// A sequence of color stops defining a color ramp
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Color_gradient). Stops are ordered by
// ascending Position.
type ColorGradient
    implements IValue
{
    Stops: Array<ColorStop>;
}
```
